page.title: VM Terminal Lab
page.heading: VM Terminal Lab
page.subtitle: Real x86 machine, running client-side in your browser via WASM — boots a real Linux, real shell, real commands
first.heading: First commands
first.body_html: Press Boot VM, wait for the login/shell prompt, then click the black screen so the keyboard focuses the VM. Try these:
first.hint: Type each command and press Enter. Restart returns you to a fresh boot if the session gets stuck.
note_html: Powered by v86 — a full x86 emulator in WebAssembly. Runtime, BIOS, and Linux image are vendored under assets/ next to this page (no live CDN required for first boot). source & licences
status.already: Already running — click the screen for keyboard
status.running: Running — click the screen, then try whoami / uname / ls
status.restarted: Restarted — click the screen when the prompt returns
